svg.title: Temperature alarm · wiring study
svg.desc: Connection-only mixed-parts wiring. Button released. Conditional formed button footprint. No alarm firmware or hardware validation.

g.text: Pushbutton · 10kΩ trim potentiometer · bare 4-pin DHT22 · LED
Fixed pairs: A1–A2, B1–B2 · switch OPEN
Sensor, threshold control, acknowledge button and indicator LED.
DHT pin 3 is NC. Button released: A1–A2 and B1–B2 only.
10kΩ DATA pull-up to 5V; 10kΩ button pull-down to ground.
Wire crossings are not junctions. Follow the insertion guide.
Button leads: assumed formed to 7.62 × 5.08mm; fit untested.
Raised / cutaway part drawings expose pins. No physical hardware test.
8 static nets · 8 components · 14 jumpers · one fixed 300-hole board
Wiring consistency only — no firmware, temperature threshold behavior, switching simulation or alarm validation.
Arduino Uno CAD-derived socket geometry · adapted illustration CC BY-SA 4.0 · component sources and assumptions in mixed-parts report
